LanguageData.IC_SettingsConvincedSuppressionDesc: A slave counts as a volunteer only if they follow the colony's primary ideoligion and their suppression is at least this high. Otherwise the assimilation is forced.
LanguageData.IC_CommandAssimilateDesc: Choose a colonist, slave or prisoner and set up their new body: race, gender, age and appearance.
LanguageData.IC_CommandCancelDesc: Forget the selected pawn and their settings.
LanguageData.IC_CommandEjectDesc: Release {0} from the pod without finishing the transformation.
LanguageData.IC_NoEligiblePawns: No colonists, slaves or prisoners on this map
LanguageData.IC_Finished: {0} leaves the assimilation pod. New race: {1}.
LanguageData.IC_LetterSeeTabs: The full record is in the Health and Log tabs.
LanguageData.IC_LogImplantsMoved: Implants moved to the new body:
LanguageData.IC_LogImplantsExtracted: Implants extracted (dropped next to the pod):
LanguageData.IC_LogHealed: Left behind with the old body:
LanguageData.IC_LogGenesRemoved: Genes removed (not allowed for the new race):
LanguageData.IC_LogGearRemoved: Gear the new body can't use (moved to inventory or dropped next to the pod):
LanguageData.IC_LogNothing: No implants, wounds, diseases, genes or gear were affected.
LanguageData.IC_RejectNotOurs: not a colonist, slave or prisoner of the colony
LanguageData.IC_RejectNotSet: Assimilation is not set up: choose a race different from the current one.
LanguageData.IC_PreviewNote: The portrait shows the current body. A preview of the new one is planned for v0.2.
LanguageData.IC_SetupForecastNote: Voluntary or forced is decided at the moment the pawn enters the pod. Numbers come from this mod's defs; other mood effects are not counted.
LanguageData.IC_ReasonColonist: Free colonist: agrees to the change.
LanguageData.IC_ReasonSlave: Slave: voluntary only if both conditions are met:
LanguageData.IC_ReasonOther: Not a member of the colony.
LanguageData.IC_CondNoIdeology: Ideology is not active, so a slave is always changed by force.
LanguageData.IC_ForecastFades: mood {0} at first, fades in about {1} days
LanguageData.IC_ForecastPermanent: mood {0} at first, after about {2} days settles at {1} forever
LanguageData.IC_ForecastBreaks: Higher risk of mental breaks during the acute phase.
LanguageData.IC_ForecastNoExtra: Your choices add no extra traumas.
LanguageData.IC_ForecastRecovery: After the pod: about {0} day(s) in a coma, fully recovered in about {1} days
LanguageData.IC_ForecastTotalLong: Total mood in the long run: {0}
LanguageData.IC_ForecastPurebloods: Purebloods of the new race: opinion {0}
